helpers/estimateDataURLDecodedBytes.js::.source:
const isBase64Char = (charCode) =>
  (charCode >= 65 && charCode <= 90) || // A-Z
  (charCode >= 97 && charCode <= 122) || // a-z
  (charCode >= 48 && charCode <= 57) || // 0-9
  charCode === 43 || // +
  charCode === 47 || // /
  charCode === 45 || // - (base64url)
  charCode === 95; // _ (base64url)

const isBase64Whitespace = (charCode) =>
  charCode === 9 || charCode === 10 || charCode === 12 || charCode === 13 || charCode === 32;

const isPercentEncodedByte = (str, i, len) =>
  i + 2 < len && isHexDigit(str.charCodeAt(i + 1)) && isHexDigit(str.charCodeAt(i + 2));

utils.js::getSafeProp.source:
const getSafeProp = (obj, prop) =>
  obj != null && hasOwnInPrototypeChain(obj, prop) ? obj[prop] : undefined;

utils.js::isBoolean.source: const isBoolean = (thing) => thing === true || thing === false;

utils.js::isObject.source: const isObject = (thing) => thing !== null && typeof thing === 'object';

utils.js::isPrototypeBoundary.source:
const isPrototypeBoundary = (obj, prototype, source) =>
  obj === Object.prototype || (!source && prototype === null);

utils.js::isSafeIterable.source:
const isSafeIterable = (thing) =>
  thing != null && hasOwnInPrototypeChain(thing, iterator) && isIterable(thing);

utils.js::isThenable.source:
const isThenable = (thing) =>
  thing &&
  (isObject(thing) || isFunction(thing)) &&
  isFunction(thing.then) &&
  isFunction(thing.catch);
